title: Implement atomic active-release cutover
description: Switch the service to a newly installed release atomically and retain enough state for deterministic rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Active release changes through a symlink or equivalent atomic cutover, not an in-place directory overwrite
The service command resolves the active release at startup and uses the same environment/data paths
A failed readiness check returns the active pointer to the previous release
The previous release remains available and is identified in status output

steps.details: Simulate a failed readiness probe and assert the active pointer remains on the previous release while the candidate is marked failed.
Create a temporary symlink and atomically rename it over the active pointer, with path validation and clear errors.
Update the unit to execute the standalone server through the active release path and reload/restart only after the pointer is ready.
Record previous/current release metadata and expose it in installer status without exposing secrets.
Run cutover failure and success fixtures plus shell syntax checks.

technicalNotes: Atomic symlink replacement is preferred; do not delete the current release until the new one is ready.
